claude-agent.why: the Claude Agent SDK runs on a Claude subscription with 5-hour/weekly usage windows; on a `rejected` rate-limit event or a 429 result the backend waits until resets_at (capped) and retries — every stage writes progress as it goes, so an interrupted run resumes where it stopped. Set on_usage_limit to `fallback` to continue on OpenRouter (paid) instead, or `fail` to stop.

codex.why: Opt-in ChatGPT subscription backend via codex exec. executable "bundled" runs the version-pinned CLI of the openai-codex-cli-bin dependency (the Codex Python SDK's runtime); a command name or path overrides it. The SDK itself drives the experimental app-server, which cannot ignore the user's ~/.codex config, so exec stays the transport. Run codex login first; API-key logins are rejected, environment API keys are excluded, and errors/usage limits fail without paid fallback. Role assignments are provisional and not dating-quality validated. Set auth_credentials_store to keyring or auto if that is where your Codex login is stored.

single_researcher.validation_status: Provisional single-agent profiles; high effort is a quality/cost hypothesis, not a measured optimum.
single_researcher.web_search_note: Profile web_search (disabled|cached|live) is discovery only: Codex's own search (cached = OpenAI's indexed copy) or Claude's WebSearch. Quotes must still come from a source retained with acquire or open; check enforces that. Enabled for codex-astra on 2026-10-04 so the researcher can find author pages and self-archived copies; codex-sol keeps it.
single_researcher.limits_note: null = uncapped. The active-time budget (prepare --research-seconds/--delivery-seconds) bounds every run; model_turns bounds Claude and OpenRouter (Codex has no native turn cap); openrouter_cost_stop_usd bounds paid runs. Caps were removed after the 2026-10-03 period pilot hit raised limits (30 acquisitions, 250 tool actions) at a third of its time budget.
